name: daintree.github
description: First-party GitHub forge provider — issues, pull requests, reviews, CI status, and rate-limit handling for github.com and GitHub Enterprise Server repositories.
tagline: Pull requests, issues, and CI checks for GitHub repositories

settings.label: GitHub Enterprise Server host
settings.description: Hostname of a GitHub Enterprise Server instance (github.example.com). Its repositories get the same pull request, issue and CI context as github.com ones.

settings.label: GitHub Enterprise Server token
settings.description: Set it in Settings → Code forge → GitHub, which checks it against the server first and stores it with the host it was saved for. A token entered here is ignored.
